title: pyrovue.json
description: Tells Pyrovue (https://pyrovue.com) how to install and start a repository. Place it at the repository's root. Every field is optional.

setup.description: Shell commands, run in order from cwd, before the app starts.

start.description: The command that serves the app. Leave it out for a library or a command-line tool.

port.description: The port the app listens on.

env.description: Environment variables for the setup commands and the app.

cwd.description: A folder inside the repository to run from, relative to its root.

previewPath.description: The path or query the preview opens first, on the app's own origin: starts with /, ? or #.

stack.description: Labels shown on the box, such as Node or Vite.

services.description: Background programs that start before start, such as a backend for the frontend that start runs. Used only when start is set.

cwd.description: The service's folder, from the repository's root. A plain relative path with no '..'.

start.description: The command that runs the service.

port.description: The port the service listens on.
